name: io.github.opikdev/mcp-server-ts-starter
title: MCP server TS starter
description: Production-ready MCP server in TypeScript, with stdio and Streamable HTTP, OAuth, and tool tests

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the notes API. Unset hides the notes tools.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token the server sends to the notes API. Required with UPSTREAM_API_URL.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for each notes API call, in milliseconds.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publishes the HTTP port on localhost.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: How HTTP callers authenticate: oauth for production, or token for static bearer tokens.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: With token: comma-separated bearer tokens, at least 16 characters each.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: With oauth: the authorization server's issuer URL. Must use https:// outside localhost.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: The URL clients use, and the expected OAuth token audience.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the server. Defaults to the MCP_PUBLIC_URL origin.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the notes API. Unset hides the notes tools.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: How the server authenticates to the notes API: static sends UPSTREAM_API_TOKEN, exchange swaps each caller's token (RFC 8693).

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: With static: the token the server sends to the notes API.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for each notes API call, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: UPSTREAM_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: With exchange: the audience to request for the notes API.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_EXCHANGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: With exchange: the authorization server's token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_EXCHANGE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: With exchange: the client ID this server authenticates as.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_EXCHANGE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: With exchange: the client secret this server authenticates with.
